# Copilot Instructions for HTML Study Project

## Project Overview
This is a personal HTML study repository containing numbered HTML files (01- to 10-) demonstrating various HTML concepts. Each file focuses on a specific topic, written in Portuguese.

## File Naming Convention
- Use format: `NN-topic.html` where NN is a two-digit number (e.g., 01-titulos.html)
- Topics are in Portuguese, lowercase, with hyphens for spaces

## HTML Structure Patterns
- Always include `<!DOCTYPE html>` and `<html lang="pt-BR">`
- Standard head structure:
  ```html
  <head>
      <meta charset="UTF-8">
      <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
      <title>Title in Portuguese</title>
  </head>
  ```
- Content and comments in Portuguese
- Use semantic HTML tags as demonstrated in [09-tags-semanticas.html](09-tags-semanticas.html)

## Content Guidelines
- Focus on practical HTML examples for learning
- Include explanatory text in Portuguese within `<p>` tags
- Demonstrate HTML elements with clear, simple examples

## Assets
- Images stored in root directory (e.g., foto gato.avif)
- Use .avif format for images

## Development Workflow
- No build process required - open HTML files directly in browser
- Edit files in VS Code for immediate preview
- Maintain sequential numbering for new topics

## Key Reference Files
- [01-titulos.html](01-titulos.html) - Basic headings example
- [09-tags-semanticas.html](09-tags-semanticas.html) - Semantic HTML introduction
